## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run test:unit` pass locally
- [ ] Routing or UI changes have a Playwright and/or unit test
- [ ] `search-embeddings.json` changed → `EMBEDDINGS_VERSION` bumped in `index.html`
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies; new dev-only top-level files are excluded in `deploy.yml`
- [ ] Docs (`README.md` / `AGENTS.md`) updated if behavior changed
